faq.title: Answers before you ask.
faq.intro: Six questions we always get, answered straight. If anything's left, just write to us.

items.a: Design, development, review and launch. And what you notice most: follow-through. We show you progress week by week and we don't leave after delivery — we stay as long as needed for the result to actually work in production.

items.q: How do you define scope and deadlines?
items.a: We start with a short call to understand your goal and define the minimum scope that solves it, with a timeline and dates. Before we write the first line of code you have a fixed proposal: what's included, how long it takes and what happens every week.

items.q: Who owns the code and the accounts?
items.a: Everything you pay for is yours. Code, domain, accounts and access are in your name from day one, and we hand everything over documented. The code also lives in a repository you can access forever.

items.q: Can you work with teams outside Argentina?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate by video call, chat and written progress updates, and our working hours overlap with the US and Europe. We already work with teams in Spain and the United States.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. After delivery there's an adjustment period and, if you want, a monthly maintenance plan that covers updates, small new features and monitoring to make sure everything keeps running.

items.q: What's the first step to work together?
items.a: You answer a guided form with seven questions, in under 2 minutes, or write to us directly on WhatsApp. Within 24 hours we reply with the next step: a call, the scope and a fixed proposal.
